name: SharePoint Integration
description: Establishes a connection between Microsoft SharePoint and the Drupal site (miniOrange).
project_description:
The SharePoint Integration module provides functionality to synchronize directories and files between Microsoft SharePoint and Drupal websites using the Microsoft Graph API. It also allows synchronizing the articles, events, user details, and other content from SharePoint, OneDrive, as well as Office 365 with the Drupal site. With this module, Drupal users can create and view SharePoint and OneDrive documents directly from the Drupal site based on their roles and permissions.

 Know more Setup Guides 

 Features : 
 
 Unified Access: The module provides a connection between your SharePoint or OneDrive Business and the Drupal website for seamless access to folders and documents, without switching between the platforms. 
 Public Document Access: Directly display publicly available documents from Sharepoint within your Drupal website, even for anonymous users. 
 Role-Based Folder Restriction: Only users with a certain role on the Drupal site will be able to access sensitive information stored in SharePoint. 
 Seamless Streaming: Stream SharePoint videos directly within the Drupal site without exposing the download link. 
 Flexible Embedding: Embed images, PDFs, Word documents, and other files into your Drupal pages with options to choose between view or edit mode. 
 Document Upload: Directly upload documents from the Drupal site to the intended SharePoint directory. 
 Real-time Content Sync: The module will fetch the articles, events, and block data published on SharePoint into Drupal pages keeping the content dynamic and updated. 
 Centralized Management: The module provides you the facility to keep all your directories, files, and media in sync across platforms like SharePoint, and OneDrive, centralizing management within Drupal. 
 Enhanced Security: Secure sensitive documents with role-based access and anonymous access options.
